facts.fact: The WARDIP Guinea-Bissau publication page lists the consultants' deliverable (interoperability framework, interoperability platform and enterprise architecture) from a feasibility study to develop an interoperability framework, commissioned by WARDIP, the World Bank, ITMA and the telecommunications and digital economy ministry; the page does not say the framework was adopted, and the page carries no event date, so the published date (2025-11) is used.

note: Page is a short acknowledgement of the consultants; no statement of adoption or use.
